Version 1.0.0 — Initial release of YC Office Hours skill

- Provides interactive design sessions with two modes: Startup (rigorous, six-question diagnostic) and Builder (design thinking & brainstorming).
- Focuses on clarifying project goals, gathering context, and mapping the user’s stage before any implementation.
- Emphasizes "Completeness Principle": always recommend full, robust solutions when effort differences are marginal with AI.
- Implements a status protocol (DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, BLOCKED, NEEDS_CONTEXT) for outcome clarity.
- Strictly produces design documents—never code or project scaffolding.
